weapon_armor_stat_formula.note: Class/Item.as:251-280 SetItemTimes(n) where n = owned copies
weapon_armor_stat_formula.n<=1: plus = baset1; multi = baset2  (shown as baset1 and (baset2+100)%)
weapon_armor_stat_formula.n>=2: lvup_multi = int(baset2*0.01 + 0.9); if <1 then 1;  lvup_plus = int(baset1*0.05 + lvup_multi*10); if <10 then 10; lvup_plus -= lvup_plus % 10; lvup_plus *= n; lvup_multi *= n; plus = baset1 + lvup_plus; multi = baset2 + lvup_multi
weapon_armor_stat_formula.apply: Class/GData.as:564-577 weapon: epatk = plus, ebatk = multi*0.01; armor: epdef = plus, ebdef = multi*0.01
weapon_armor_stat_formula.final: Class/GData.as:750-754 eX = epX + (epX + baseX) * ebX ; battle uses baseX + eX

slots.used: 0=weapon, 1=armor, 2..7 accessory (full), 8..9 mini (<=2 stars), 10..11 mini (1 star only); 12..15 unused (-2)
